scientific_integrity: Mathematical theorem proved analytically and tested by self-review reproducibility checks only; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only equal birth weights, two positive frailty atoms, and a common positive Gompertz age slope; no empirical validation, unequal weights, gamma frailty, or general distribution claims. Historically prior specialized classifications may exist.
title: Sharp age-shape phase boundaries for a two-frailty Gompertz cohort
